items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions Shirley Scott in the context of a club room where she played, but does not describe a personal or professional relationship with her.

ctx.x: Another room especially that Basie worked in, and a room that was an organ group – it was a room that played mostly organs. That’s where Shirley Scott and – even Basie played organ in there – this particular club – with a small group, before the big-band – all his big-band experience, which came later on. The uptown, or Harlem, clubs catered to more of especially creative things. In other words, they did more shows where they would have a comedian and a singer and then a tap-dancer or something. It was more like…
I want to jump back to Chicago a little bit, because we – the Garrick Stage Bar. That’s where you had hooked up with Stuff.
